 Inspiration 

 There is a groundswell of interest within Canada for buying Canadian products from fellow Canadians right now. 

 What it does 

 Enables Canadian consumers to search and browse categorized products from Canadian retailers who use the Shopify platform, and highlights products which are made in Canada. 

 How we built it 

 Shopify recently allowed access to the global product catalog, allowing us to structure queries to surface items specific to our special interests. This site leverages that to pull in products shipped from Canadian stores, to Canadian buyers, and tags them if they mention that they are made in Canada. 

 Challenges we ran into 

 Query limits; needing multiple queries to tag items as mentioning "made in Canada" as well as the French equivalents; using local data structures to temporarily store query results for sorting and filtering while staying within the guidelines for Shopify's global catalog usage. 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 It really is a showcase of the scope and variety of great things that Canadians contribute to the world. Other sites have had merchants trickle onto them by signing up for listings, while this one immediately surfaces thousands of Canadian creations. 

 What we learned 

 The Shopify global catalog is a rich source of product information, supporting niche sites and special-interest groups; there are endless possibilities! For the past year, analyzing Shopify Collective as a way to accomplish this seemed like a full-time job of contract negotiations and convincing Canadian merchants to join Collective as a supplier. This is a far better route to quickly surface all things Canadian from Shopify's vast range of stores. 

 What's next for Buy Canadian from the Shopify Global Catalog 

 If it is accepted into the Promoted Placements dev preview program, there will be a source of revenue for paid hosting (currently "hobby" plan on Vercel) and a properly branded standalone domain name. :) 
Features: additional filtering on category pages by subcategories, and additional query filters for Canadian stores which ship to other countries beyond Canada (allowing folks outside of Canada who want to support Canadian merchants a way to find items which will ship to their country).
